<function name="SetPathID" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Sets the path ID (<page>File Search Paths</page>) for populating the tree from the filesystem.

Use <page>DTree_Node:MakeFolder</page> instead.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="path" type="string">The path ID to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
